import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.NormalizedComparison

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
  TopologicalSpace CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups

open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
  [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))

set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "XB" => (C ⊗ overSpec k B).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "Xq" => (C ⊗ overSpec k (B ⊗[A] B)).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "Xcb" => (C ⊗ overSpec k (B ⊗[A] (B ⊗[A] B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "u₁" => (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorInl (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "w₁₂" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₂ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left

namespace Over

/-- probe copy of the insertion def -/
noncomputable def insertionProbe₁ : Xcb ⟶ XB := w₁₂ ≫ (u₁)

set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "v₁" => Over.insertionProbe₁ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B) C

-- Probe 0: the identification, alone.
lemma probe_comp_inl : w₁₂ ≫ (u₁) = v₁ := rfl

-- Probe 1: the insertion applied to a point, alone.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (z : Xcb) : (XB).Opens :=
  𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z)

-- Probe 2: the preimage alone.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (z : Xcb) : (Xcb).Opens :=
  (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z)

-- Probe 3: the inf preimage.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (z z' : Xcb) : (Xcb).Opens :=
  (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z'))

-- Probe 4: the ≤ statement against ⊥.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (z z' : Xcb) :
    (⊥ : (Xcb).Opens)
      ≤ (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z')) := by
  sorry

set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "w₁₃" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₁₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left
set_option quotPrecheck false in
local notation "w₂₃" =>
  (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap (tensorFace₂₃ (k := k) (A := A) (B := B))).left

/-- probe copy of the product cover -/
noncomputable def productCoverProbe (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover) : (Xcb).PointedCover :=
  (𝒲.pullback (w₂₃) ⊓ 𝒲.pullback (w₁₂)) ⊓ 𝒲.pullback (w₁₃)

/-- probe copy of the pair open -/
noncomputable def pairOpenProbe (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover) (z z' : Xcb) : (Xcb).Opens :=
  (productCoverProbe C 𝒲).opens z ⊓ (productCoverProbe C 𝒲).opens z'

-- Probe 5: the ≤ statement against the pair open, no hW₁ binder.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover) (z z' : Xcb) :
    pairOpenProbe C 𝒲 z z'
      ≤ (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z')) := by
  sorry

-- Probe 6: the ≤ statement against ⊥, WITH the hW₁ binder.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover)
    (hW₁ : ∀ x, 𝒲.opens x ≤ (u₁) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒩.opens ((u₁).base x)) (z z' : Xcb) :
    (⊥ : (Xcb).Opens)
      ≤ (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z')) := by
  sorry

-- Probe 7: the full real statement (pair open + hW₁ binder).
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover)
    (hW₁ : ∀ x, 𝒲.opens x ≤ (u₁) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒩.opens ((u₁).base x)) (z z' : Xcb) :
    pairOpenProbe C 𝒲 z z'
      ≤ (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z')) := by
  sorry

-- Probe 8: bare projection as an argument value.
example (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) : (XB : Scheme.{u}) → (XB).Opens := 𝒩.opens

/-- probe copy of the abstract composite-bound transfer -/
theorem probe_le_preimage_inf_of_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (φ : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ Z) (t : X ⟶ Z) (h : φ ≫ r = t)
    (V : Z → Z.Opens) (W : Y → Y.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ y : Y, W y ≤ r ⁻¹ᵁ V (r.base y))
    (x x' : X) {O : X.Opens}
    (hO : O ≤ φ ⁻¹ᵁ (W (φ.base x) ⊓ W (φ.base x'))) :
    O ≤ t ⁻¹ᵁ (V (t.base x) ⊓ V (t.base x')) := by
  subst h
  exact hO.trans (φ.preimage_mono (r.le_preimage_inf
    (inf_le_left.trans (hW (φ.base x))) (inf_le_right.trans (hW (φ.base x')))))

lemma probe_pairOpen_le_face₁₂ (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover) (z z' : Xcb) :
    pairOpenProbe C 𝒲 z z'
      ≤ (w₁₂) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒲.opens ((w₁₂).base z) ⊓ 𝒲.opens ((w₁₂).base z')) :=
  (w₁₂).le_preimage_inf
    (inf_le_left.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))
    (inf_le_right.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right))

-- Probe 9: the full real bound lemma, statement + proof.
lemma probe_pairOpen_le_insertion₁ (𝒩 : (XB).PointedCover) (𝒲 : (Xq).PointedCover)
    (hW₁ : ∀ x, 𝒲.opens x ≤ (u₁) ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒩.opens ((u₁).base x)) (z z' : Xcb) :
    pairOpenProbe C 𝒲 z z'
      ≤ (v₁) ⁻¹ᵁ (𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z) ⊓ 𝒩.opens ((v₁).base z')) :=
  probe_le_preimage_inf_of_comp (w₁₂) (u₁) (v₁) (probe_comp_inl C)
    𝒩.opens 𝒲.opens hW₁ z z'
    (probe_pairOpen_le_face₁₂ C 𝒲 z z')

end Over

end AlgebraicGeometry
